name: Research agenda

subjectOf.text: More research and empirical work is needed to determine how CIAs and other hybrid forms may change or expand directors' obligations.
subjectOf.abstract: More research and empirical work may be needed to explore how CIAs and other hybrid forms may change or expand directors' obligations.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Elizabeth R. Malay, The Role of Corporate Integrity Agreements in the Expansion of Fiduciary Duties (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2317580

subjectOf.text: More research is needed to understand how dynamic forms of governance could help improve fiduciary duties and corporate governance.
subjectOf.abstract: More research may be needed to understand how dynamic forms of governance could help improve fiduciary duties and corporate governance.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, A Comparative Perspective on the Limitations of the Duty of Oversight – A Comment on Lisa Fairfax (2013)

subjectOf.text: Quantum economics models must be subjected to empirical testing and to rigorous head to head comparison with classical models across different economic contexts and datasets before their validity and generalizability can be established.
subjectOf.abstract: Another important implication of the debates surrounding quantum economics is the need for more empirical testing and validation of quantum economics models.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and Tokenomics (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900878

subjectOf.text: Testnet deployment must evaluate weighted voting and microsecond-scale updates against Sybil attacks, collusion, and reputation gaming across adversarial scenarios of ten, thirty-three, and fifty percent malicious participation before SPoS's theoretical strengths can be treated as practical resilience.
subjectOf.abstract: Testnet deployments should evaluate both weighted voting and microsecond-scale updates against Sybil attacks, collusion, and reputation gaming under adversarial scenarios (e.g., 10%, 33%, 50% malicious participation), using real-time data and high-performance testbeds
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Cryptographic Foundations and Interdisciplinary Dimensions of the Secure Proof of Stake (SPoS) Conse (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5225296
